messages:
sasha: noticing a weird churn pattern in us-west2 tiny-job queues. lots of 0.01-0.03 GPU pods getting evicted then rescheduled repeatedly. cost pulse and attach/detach logs both trending up :thinking_face:

mike: saw that too. kubelet logs show rapid attach/detach followed by NodeReady flips for a few seconds then back. probably causing NVLink/NIC thrash on the rack.

anna: dug into scheduler metrics. there's a new 'micro_pack_reserved_quota' check that's returning high reserved_quota values when inflight small-requests spike. snippet:
```
I0415 14:02:11.402 micro_packer.go:134] evaluateReserve node=wk-usw2-rack3 reserved_quota=0.62 incoming=0.02 reason=conservative_heuristic
I0415 14:02:11.403 scheduler.go:847] reject pod tiny-job-923 reason=reserve_conflict
```

carla: where did micro_pack come from? is that the fractional packing rollout from last month?

sasha: yes, the micro-pack allocator. it tries to keep a safety margin per node for attach/detach capacity but it's not accounting for multiplexing of tiny pods. at high fanout it over-reserves and blocks scheduling, which triggers other controllers to evict and reshuffle.

mike: quick repro: spawn 60 tiny pods across 5 namespaces in us-west2, watch `micro_pack_reserved_quota` and node attach ops. you'll see the reserve jump then a sequence of preempts.

anna: short-term mitigation I propose toggling micro_pack.relaxed_mode=true for us-west2. tested in staging: relax=true reduced preemptions by ~68% and node Ready flaps by ~80%. cpu on kubelets unchanged.

carla: ops runbook if we flip: 1) patch feature flag on controller 2) set per-rack tiny_pod_rate throttle to 200/s 3) watch nvlink_tx_errors and attach_latency. if nvlink errors spike, rollback.

devops-bot: Patch start: set micro_pack.relaxed_mode=true (sha: f9d8e7). Target: us-west2 canaries (rack3, rack4). Rollout timeout 10m.

sasha: rolling now to racks 3/4 in us-west2. will monitor preemptions and token-cost.

mike: long-term fix: update heuristic to treat <0.05 GPU requests as multiplexable with factor=10 and cap reserved_quota to 0.2. also add a decay window so temporary spikes don't keep quota high.

anna: add metric `micro_pack_reserve_conflicts_total{size=\"micro\"}` and an alert when >10/min. also emit `node_attach_detach_rate` per-rack for correlation.

carla: opened ENGPLAT-2410 with proposed heuristic, perf sims, and estimated cost impact (~9% lower tiny-pod overhead). link in the ticket includes sim output and staging grafana panels.

sasha: thumbs up. for now watch us-west2 for 30-60m post-rollout. I'll post updates here if anything regresses. :eyes:
